summary.text: Neal Carter is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 15; the Arizona Legislature's member page lists the position of Speaker Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Carter has been a District 15 homeowner since 2010, is married to Katy, and volunteers locally with a church.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 15 (candidate-submitted statements)
